$description: The vocabulary of ui-materials as data: what each concept means, what it is for, what it is not, and which names it owns; plus the closed sets (settings, material presets, part attributes, anatomy, elevation levels), the material-token catalogue and the palette inputs with their ui-colors defaults. One term, one meaning: `aliases` are accepted spellings, `avoid` are words not to use for it. scripts/check.mjs keeps SKILL.md, the references and ui-showcase-bento's source in step with this file.

principles.rule: A material never changes a length.
principles.why: Lengths are ui-geometry's; if paint moved a box, switching material would move the layout.

principles.rule: A component knows each part's layer, relief and face, never the material.
principles.why: A new material is then a new preset, and no component changes.

principles.rule: A word names one concept, and a word a sibling skill owns keeps that skill's meaning.
principles.why: ui-colors owns ground, surface, ink, role, accent, mode, scheme and theme; ui-geometry owns edge, tier and elevation levels; ui-showcase-bento owns specimen, group and the canvas. Reusing them for something else lets two skills agree on a word and disagree on the paint.

concepts.definition: A named preset of the four settings (lighting, transmission, delineation, chroma): Flat, Physical, Frosted glass, Glass or Outline (ids flat, physical, frosted, glass, outline).
concepts.intent: Naming a combination a product ships, so one attribute switches all four settings.
concepts.not: Not Apple's materials (blur thicknesses, which are transmission levels here), not Material Design, not ui-colors' Material palette (a neutral source ramp), not a ui-geometry preset (a set of length constants).

concepts.definition: One of four independent paint switches, each a closed set of values: lighting, transmission, delineation, chroma.
concepts.intent: Composing any material from four small tables instead of writing one table per material.
concepts.not: Not a ui-colors mode (light, dark, dim, contrast), which changes colours, not paint.

concepts.definition: The setting that adds one light from above (lit) or none (none): face shading, bevels, casts, inward recess shadows, lamp glows.
concepts.intent: Depth from shading alone, with every fill kept.

concepts.definition: The setting for what an overlay body, and a cover pane over a display, does with what is behind it: opaque hides it, frosted diffuses it (16px blur), clear keeps it legible (3px blur, plus the lens where it runs).
concepts.intent: Glass on the layers that float, and nowhere else.
concepts.not: Not a property of a part: it never touches ground, raised, solid or emissive faces.

concepts.definition: The setting that draws parts with fills (fill) or with a 1px line inside each box (line), keeping fills only where they carry state.
concepts.intent: A wireframe or high-contrast rendering of the same components.

concepts.definition: The setting that keeps colour (colour) or maps the primary solid, emissive faces, data and media to one neutral ink (mono).
concepts.intent: A monochrome rendering where no meaning rests on hue.

concepts.definition: Refraction added to clear transmission: the backdrop seen through a superellipse displacement map that leaves the centre and bends the rim a few pixels, each colour channel a little more.
concepts.intent: Making clear glass read as glass.
concepts.not: Not a material and not a setting value: where it cannot run, clear stays clear and never becomes frosted. An engine check is necessary, not sufficient.

concepts.definition: One stage of painting: the five composition passes (fills, delineation, lighting, transmission, chroma) and, inside lighting, the paint passes (base, face shading, bevel, cast, texture, context).
concepts.intent: Each pass rewrites only the tokens it owns, so the settings compose in any combination.
concepts.not: Not a ui-colors step (a position on a 12-step ramp) and not the layer attribute.

concepts.definition: A painted element of a component, described by its layer, relief and face.
concepts.intent: The unit a component author classifies and a material paints.
concepts.not: Not a mark.

concepts.definition: A part attribute: base (in the content) or overlay (floating above it: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, sheets, floating and tab bars).
concepts.intent: Deciding what transmission may touch.
concepts.not: Not a paint pass and not one of ui-geometry's cast layers.

concepts.definition: The layer above the content. Its body is the ground of its own layer, and its own parts are raised or recessed relative to that body.
concepts.intent: Menus, dialogs and bars that float, and can turn to glass.

concepts.definition: A part attribute: ground (the part others sit on), raised (stands out of its ground; you move it), etched (level with its ground; it shows a value that is not open for typing) or recessed (cut into it; it holds a value or a finger).
concepts.intent: Choosing paint by job: raise what you move, etch what you show, recess what holds.

concepts.definition: The relief value of the part others sit on: the page, a device housing, an overlay's body, a card that holds parts.
concepts.intent: Nesting: whatever holds parts is their ground.
concepts.not: Not ui-colors' ground family (the page's neutral colour). The page's base ground is painted with that family; other grounds (cards, overlay bodies) are painted with ui-colors' surface family.

concepts.definition: A part attribute, what the face is made of: neutral (the neutral fill), solid (a strong fill), emissive (light) or display (a screen you read through). A neutral face is painted by its relief's token (--ground-face, --raised-face, --recessed-face), a solid face by --solid-face, a display face by --display-face and an emissive face by --emissive.
concepts.intent: Separating what carries meaning (solid, emissive) from what only holds.

concepts.definition: A lamp that is off: a recessed part with a neutral face, lit from above on its lower inner wall.
concepts.intent: Drawing off as a place, not as a grey lamp.

concepts.definition: The strong fill of a solid face: ui-colors' --colors-primary-solid by default, read through the --accent input.
concepts.intent: The one filled action, and latched or on states.
concepts.not: Not ui-colors' accent (any non-neutral family).

concepts.definition: The solid face of a part chosen alone (a current page, a single-select option): ui-colors' bg-inverse by default, read through the --select input, with --on-selected for its marks. A row chosen among several takes the tint instead (--tint-face, read through --tint): a quiet state fill with no relief, while the checked box in its leading slot carries the selection.
concepts.intent: Showing what is chosen without spending the primary solid, which stays the action's.
concepts.not: Not the primary solid. Not the thumb of a segmented control or tabs, which is the white raised neutral in both schemes.

concepts.definition: What is printed on a face: ink (labels, scales, ticks, legends, rules) and data (series, values). It has no relief and takes no shadow. A mark that shows live state (a diagram's live path) may take the emissive colour, with no glow.
concepts.intent: Print what you read.
concepts.not: Not a part. Its ink colours are ui-colors' ink family (the fg roles); this skill does not define ink colours.

concepts.definition: The lighting pass on a raised part: a lit 1px inset on top, a faint shade 1px inset at the bottom and a half-pixel shade ring.
concepts.intent: Catching the light on an edge without a stroke colour.
concepts.not: Not ui-geometry's edge (where content starts or a box ends).

concepts.definition: The shadow a raised part or overlay throws: ui-geometry's elevation layers at one level, coloured with shade and shifted by the light.
concepts.intent: Showing height.

concepts.definition: One of the L stacked drops ui-geometry's elevation computes for a level.
concepts.intent: Lengths for a cast, owned by ui-geometry.
concepts.not: Not the layer attribute.

concepts.definition: ui-geometry's named elevation level a cast uses: raised for controls, popup for resting cards and popovers, floating for floating bars, modal for dialogs.
concepts.intent: One level name per part, shared with ui-geometry.
concepts.not: Not the raised relief value, though one word names both: say 'the raised level' for the cast.

concepts.definition: An overlay body under frosted or clear transmission: a translucent face over a backdrop filter, with a rim when lit.
concepts.intent: A floating layer you can see through.

concepts.definition: Glass in front of a display face under frosted or clear transmission, when lit: its lit lower inner edge and reflections over the display. It never changes the display's relief.
concepts.intent: A meter or readout behind glass.
concepts.not: Not drawn without lighting (a pane is seen only through its reflections), and never over a neutral recess such as a field, well, track or tray, which would read as a raised panel.

concepts.definition: The lit highlight along the edge of a glass body, drawn only when lighting is lit.
concepts.intent: Drawing a pane's boundary with light.
concepts.not: Not the 2–3% darker ring a round raised part takes in face shading, and not the bevel.

concepts.definition: The filter an overlay body applies to what is behind it (--overlay-backdrop): blur, saturation, brightness and the lens.
concepts.intent: Transmission's effect on the backdrop.
concepts.not: Not ui-colors' backdrop (the veil behind a dialog), which this skill calls a scrim.

concepts.definition: The veil behind a modal overlay: an overlay-layer fill, ui-colors' --colors-bg-backdrop.
concepts.intent: The dialog reads as the only layer.
concepts.not: Not a shadow and not the backdrop filter.

concepts.definition: A CSS custom property a component paints with, named by relief, face and layer (--raised-face, --recessed-shadow, --overlay-backdrop …). The passes write them; tokens below lists each with its writers.
concepts.intent: Components never hold a colour or a shadow, so every material works unchanged.
concepts.not: Not a ui-colors role (--colors-<role>): material tokens read roles through the palette inputs.

concepts.definition: A colour a material reads from the palette (--bg, --element, --recess …), each defaulting to a ui-colors role (inputs below).
concepts.intent: One seam between colour and paint: map the inputs once and every material follows.

concepts.definition: Light or dark, ui-colors' polarity of a mode. The scheme constants are set per scheme.
concepts.intent: Saying which polarity paint is tuned for, in ui-colors' word.
concepts.not: Not a theme (a named ui-colors request) and not a material.

concepts.definition: A number a table reads per scheme: --glass-k, the brightness a transmissive body applies to its backdrop. --shade, --shade-k and --lit-k are retired: the scheme multipliers in paint.json do their job when the colour system is generated.
concepts.intent: Dark schemes need glass that darkens its backdrop.

concepts.definition: A shade, lit or glass colour at a fixed alpha that a lit or transmissive table paints with, named by use: --colors-paint-<use>. references/paint.json declares each one, scripts/request.mjs asks ui-colors for them, and ui-colors generates them as literals in every mode.
concepts.intent: Every colour in the paint is generated and can be audited; nothing is derived in the browser.
concepts.not: Not a palette input (an alias a component can remap) and not a built-in ui-colors role: ui-colors emits a paint role only for a request that asks for it. Flat and Outline use none.

foreign.meaning: the neutral family of cards, panels, wells and floating layers
the neutral family of text; marks are painted with it
a named request with all its modes
where content starts or a box ends
a labelled drawing in a group
a labelled set of specimens on the canvas

--element.for: raised and overlay neutral faces; ui-colors emits surface only with neutrals, so a one-neutral system reads bg; the dark scheme reads bg-muted, so a raised face stays lighter than its ground

--overlay.for: overlay neutral faces; ui-colors emits bg-overlay only with neutrals (two steps above the card in the dark scheme), so a one-neutral system reads the raised face's input

--element-pressed.for: a pressed part's face; the dark scheme reads bg-subtle, so a held key stays darker than the key at rest

--recess.for: recessed neutral faces; the dark scheme reads bg, so a recess stays darker than its ground

--etch.for: etched neutral faces: one step off the ground, distinct from the recessed and the disabled fill

--display.for: display faces: ui-colors' dark endpoint, the same in every mode, so a screen stays dark in a dark scheme

--accent-pressed.for: a solid part held down: one step further from its rest fill than hover (ui-colors' pressed solid)

--select.for: the selected face: a part chosen alone (a current page, a single-select option)

--tint.for: the tint: a row chosen among several, with no relief; a neutral step ui-colors holds to apca.ui against a resting row

--line.for: the faint line under delineation: line

--line-strong.for: the strong line and operable boundaries (held to ui-colors' apca.ui threshold)
